section.name: file-upload-sanitization
section.description: Every file upload MUST sanitize the original filename and restrict permissions. These patterns were established after fixing 16 vulnerable upload sites across 13 files.

pattern.name: filename-sanitization
pattern.rule: Strip all characters except alphanumeric, dot, hyphen, underscore
pattern.appliesTo: Any call to getClientOriginalName() before storage

pattern.name: image-extension-whitelist
pattern.rule: For image uploads, validate extension against whitelist

pattern.name: base64-validation
pattern.rule: Validate base64 payloads strictly before writing to disk

section.name: sql-injection-prevention
section.description: Raw SQL fragments (whereRaw, selectRaw, FIND_IN_SET) MUST use parameterized bindings. 16 sites were fixed across 5 files.

pattern.name: no-raw-interpolation
pattern.rule: Never interpolate PHP variables into raw SQL strings

section.name: logging-hygiene
section.description: Sensitive data MUST NOT appear in logs. Bearer tokens, cookies, and passwords must be masked or excluded.

pattern.name: header-filtering
pattern.rule: Filter sensitive headers before logging request context

section.name: console-output-safety
section.description: HTTP code paths must not write to ConsoleOutput (stdout pollution, info leak). Use the SafeConsoleOutput helper.

pattern.name: safe-console-output
pattern.rule: In HTTP context, use NullOutput instead of ConsoleOutput

section.name: frontend-xss-prevention
section.description: JavaScript in public/assets/js/ MUST NOT use innerHTML with dynamic data. 14 files were refactored from innerHTML to safe DOM construction.

pattern.name: toast-dom-construction
pattern.description: Pattern A: Simple text messages (11 files)

pattern.name: server-html-via-template
pattern.description: Pattern B: Server-rendered HTML that must be parsed (3 files)

pattern.name: form-action-validation
pattern.description: Dynamic form actions must be validated against safe URL patterns

pattern.name: no-document-write
pattern.rule: Replace document.write with DOM API methods

checklist.item: No bearerToken() value in log context?
HTTP code uses SafeConsoleOutput::make(), not new ConsoleOutput()?

section.name: deferred-security-items
section.description: Known security items deferred for future work. Not blocking current deployment but should be addressed before production exposure.

deferred.title: Cross-controller IDOR / tenant scoping
deferred.detail: UserController, EmployeeController, ClientController, RoleController, JobCategoryController, CompanyPolicyController, ProjectController lack tenant-scoped query guards. Needs a global scope or scoped query helper.

deferred.title: Shared-link base64 passwords
deferred.detail: Shared links store passwords as base64 instead of Hash::make(). Migration required to invalidate existing links and re-hash.

deferred.title: JobController::jobApplyData() auth ambiguity
deferred.detail: Calls _checkLogin() on a route that appears to be a public guest endpoint. Needs product decision: is account required for job applications?
